Hi, we are currently using Dataverse version 6.11 in our installation and I have tried to configure datasetTypes, but when creating a new dataset with one of the configured values, from the DataCite side and in the DataCite export format the resourceTypeGeneral value still shows as "Dataset".

I have configured the following extra datasetTypes: software and outputdatamanagementplan. Then I added these values to allowedDatasetTypes for a collection.

One of our users tried to create a new dataset using the dataset type outputdatamanagementplan, in the dataset table the column datasettype_id has the correct value, but when the metadata is exported in DataCite format and the DOI is registered in DataCite the resourceTypeGeneral is set to Dataset.

This is the URL for the dataset metadata:
https://qa.datahub.polen.fccn.pt/api/datasets/export?exporter=Datacite&persistentId=doi%3A10.82210/TOI11B

Am I missing something in the configuration or in the dataset JSON when creating the dataset?

Hi César,
I think that the problem is that the Dataverse code does not recognize the outputmanagementplan as a type when creating DataCite metadata:
https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/blob/6178c37ca872f20bf3ec6ac3ba7eb237b33bcf3c/src/main/java/edu/harvard/iq/dataverse/pidproviders/doi/XmlMetadataTemplate.java#L875

It could need a new line in the code.

We would be interested in the outputmanagementplan resourceTypeGeneral and it is supported by the DataCite schema. @Philip Durbin 🚀 , Should we open a PR and pull request?
I have created an issue to request a feature to support outputmanagementplan resourceTypeGeneral and the respective pull request.
@César Ferreira thanks for the pull request! I just left you a review. Please feel free to ask questions either here or there.
